content:
If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is >0.67 and true price exceeds forecast by >2%, adjust next forecast up by 1–2% for late horizon (16–30 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is below true price by >1.5%, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is above true price by >1.5%, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon.
